title: Policy gates for data exfiltration: scoped IP enforcement, share-blocking, and export locks
creator: Morgan Li
description: Build first-class admin policy gates to prevent data exfiltration across the Console and API surface. Work scopes three independent but related controls: (1) scoped IP enforcement (org-level and route-level allowlists with CIDR ranges and exception pods), (2) share-blocking toggle to disable public link generation and cross-org sharing, and (3) export locks which prevent downloads/embeddings/clipboard exports for datasets and audit-sensitive artifacts. These controls must integrate with RBAC v2 (so org admins can delegate exceptions), emit enriched audit log entries (actor, policy, rationale, enforcement decision), and respect SSO/SAML attribute mappings for admin-level overrides. Enforcement points: API gateway (edge), Console UI (client + server validation), and background jobs (export processors). This ticket covers design, API contract, gate implementation, audit enrichment, e2e tests, rollout plan (canary + org opt-in + enforcement escalation), and observability dashboards for policy hits, false-positive rates, and impact on latency.
acceptance_criteria: Admin UI toggle for each policy available under Organization > Security with audit history visible
Policy decisions enforced at API gateway for all RPCs and streaming endpoints (deny or soft-block with user-visible message)
Audit logs include policy_id, policy_name, decision, actor_id, reason, request_context and are forwarded to customer audit sinks and internal ELK
RBAC v2 permission model supports granularity: org_admin, security_officer, export_exempt role and exceptions table
SAML/SSO attribute mapping supports mapping of external group to 'export_exempt' for specific IdPs
Automated e2e tests covering console flows, API clients, and export processors
Rollout plan executed: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with rollback plan and emergency bypass via dedicated admin JWT
comments: 2025-11-03 Morgan Li: Initial proposal posted. Goal is to close gaps discovered during Q3 incident where a misconfigured export job allowed cross-org dataset copying. Proposed three policy types and enforcement at gateway + export processor. Laying out RBAC v2 dependencies.

2025-11-10 Security Review (Eva Martinez): Raised requirement to include immutable audit event IDs and HMAC signing of audit payloads for customer audit sinks. Also requested SSO/IdP mapping examples for Okta and Azure AD.

2025-11-18 Sofia Patel: Design review notes incorporated. Decided to use a scoped allowlist model (org-level default deny with explicit route exceptions) to avoid silent permission leakage. Trade-off: slightly higher configuration complexity for admins vs stronger safety. Added export_exempt role in RBAC v2.

2025-11-26 Engineering update (Sofia Patel): Implemented API contract v1 for /orgs/{org}/policies. Gateway hook added to request pipeline with cache TTL=60s to avoid per-request DB hits. Need to evaluate cache consistency on role changes (follow-up task created ENG-32111).

2025-12-02 QA (Julian Park): Found an edge case where streaming token responses bypass client-side share-block check; added server-side enforcement for streaming endpoints. Filed subtask ENG-32112 to add integration tests for streaming.

2025-12-08 Ops (Leah Johnson): Dashboard prototype available at Grafana link. Initial metrics: policy_denies=312 in canary orgs, average gateway lat increase +3ms. Recommend rolling caches to reduce stale allowlist window; add rollout step to invalidate cache on role change.
2025-12-12 Product (Noah Kim): Approved rollout plan. Customer communications drafted for admins (email + Console banner). Confirmed SLA for emergency bypass is acceptable for enterprise customers.
2025-12-12 Sofia Patel: Security review requested (formal). Attaching PR and Confluence doc. Next: complete audit enrichment and add HMAC signing per Eva's note before full rollout.
